entries.title: I Chronicles 8:1
segments: ¶Now Benjamin begot Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:2
segments: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:3
segments: The sons of Bela [were] Addar, Gera, Abihud,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:4
segments: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:5
segments: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:6
segments: These [are] the sons of Ehud, who were the heads of the fathers' [houses] of the inhabitants of Geba, and who forced them to move to Manahath:

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:7
segments: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera who forced them to move. He begot Uzza and Ahihud.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:8
segments: And Shaharaim had children in the country of Moab, after he had sent away Hushim and Baara his wives.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:9
segments: By Hodesh his wife he begot Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:10
segments: Jeuz, Sachiah, and Mirmah. These [were] his sons, heads of their fathers' [houses].

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:11
segments: And by Hushim he begot Abitub and Elpaal.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:12
segments: The sons of Elpaal [were] Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod with its towns;

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:13
segments: and Beriah and Shema, who [were] heads of their fathers' [houses] of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove out the inhabitants of Gath.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:14
segments: Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:15
segments: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:16
segments: Michael, Ispah, and Joha [were] the sons of Beriah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:17
segments: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:18
segments: Ishmerai, Jizliah, and Jobab [were] the sons of Elpaal.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:19
segments: Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:20
segments: Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:21
segments: Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath [were] the sons of Shimei.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:22
segments: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:23
segments: Abdon, Zichri, Hanan,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:24
segments: Hananiah, Elam, Antothijah,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:25
segments: Iphdeiah, and Penuel [were] the sons of Shashak.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:26
segments: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:27
segments: Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri [were] the sons of Jeroham.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:28
segments: These [were] heads of the fathers' [houses] by their generations, chief men. These dwelt in Jerusalem.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:29
segments: Now the father of Gibeon, whose wife's name [was] Maacah, dwelt at Gibeon.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:30
segments: And his firstborn son [was] Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:31
segments: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:32
segments: and Mikloth, [who] begot Shimeah. They also dwelt alongside their relatives in Jerusalem, with their brethren.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:33
segments: ¶Ner begot Kish, Kish begot Saul, and Saul begot Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Esh-Baal.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:34
segments: The son of Jonathan [was] Merib-Baal, and Merib-Baal begot Micah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:35
segments: The sons of Micah [were] Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:36
segments: And Ahaz begot Jehoaddah; Jehoaddah begot Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begot Moza.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:37
segments: Moza begot Binea, Raphah his son, Eleasah his son, [and] Azel his son.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:38
segments: Azel had six sons whose names [were] these: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these [were] the sons of Azel.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:39
segments: And the sons of Eshek his brother [were] Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:40
segments: The sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor-archers. [They] had many sons and grandsons, one hundred and fifty [in all]. These [were] all sons of Benjamin.
